--- original

@@ -0,0 +1,47 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8480'
+title: 'Upstream (FoundationModelsACP): add ClientSideConnection.afterRespondingToCurrentRequest'
+---
+## What
+
+**This change is in the FoundationModelsACP package (sibling repository `swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsACP`), not in this package.** It is the prerequisite of task "selectPermission and cancelPermission wait for the written response". This client cannot know when the response frame of a `session/request_permission` is written to the transport. FoundationModelsACP has the mechanism, but only the agent side exposes it:
+
+- `Connection.dispatchRequest` (`Sources/FoundationModelsACP/Connection/Connection.swift:788`) binds a `ResponseHooks` value to the task-local `Connection.currentResponseHooks`, calls the handler, writes the response in `completeInbound`, and then calls `hooks.runAll()`. A connection that closed before the write calls `hooks.discardAll()`.
+- `AgentSideConnection.afterRespondingToCurrentRequest(_:)` (`Sources/FoundationModelsACP/Connection/AgentSideConnection.swift:263`) is the public entry point. `ClientSideConnection` has none.
+- `ClientSideConnection.serve(_:params:to:)` (`Sources/FoundationModelsACP/Connection/ClientSideConnection.swift:175`) calls `client.requestPermission` directly on the dispatch task, so the task-local is in scope in the `Client` handler.
+
+Change:
+
+1. In `Sources/FoundationModelsACP/Connection/ClientSideConnection.swift`, add `public func afterRespondingToCurrentRequest(_ work: @escaping @Sendable () async -> Void)` with the same body and the same doc contract as the agent-side method: run after the response is given to the transport; dropped outside an inbound request; released when the connection closed before the write.
+2. Better: also add a `discarded` signal, so a caller that waits on the work is not left suspended when the hooks are discarded. For example `afterRespondingToCurrentRequest(_ work:, ifNotWritten: @escaping @Sendable () async -> Void)`, or a `Bool` argument to `work` (`written`). Choose one form for both sides, and keep the old agent-side signature.
+3. Push FoundationModelsACP `main`, then run `swift package update FoundationModelsACP` in this package and commit `Package.resolved`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] A `Client.requestPermission` handler that calls `connection.afterRespondingToCurrentRequest` sees its work run after the response frame is written.
+- [ ] A call outside an inbound request does not run the work.
+- [ ] When the connection closes before the write, the work does not run and the "not written" signal runs. No caller stays suspended.
+- [ ] `AgentSideConnection.afterRespondingToCurrentRequest(_:)` keeps its signature and its tests pass.
+- [ ] This package resolves the new FoundationModelsACP revision, and `swift build` here gives no new warning.
+
+## Tests
+
+- In FoundationModelsACP, add tests beside `Tests/FoundationModelsACPTests/ResponseHooksTests.swift` (new file `Tests/FoundationModelsACPTests/ClientResponseHooksTests.swift`), over an in-memory transport pair with a recording agent side. No sleeps:
+  - `clientHookRunsAfterThePermissionResponseIsWritten`
+  - `clientHookOutsideARequestDoesNotRun`
+  - `clientHookIsDiscardedAndSignalledWhenTheConnectionClosesFirst`
+- Command (in FoundationModelsACP): `swift test --filter ClientResponseHooksTests`, then `swift test`.
+- Command (here, after the update): `swift build` and `swift test`.
+
+## Workflow
+
+Use /tdd — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
+
+## Subtasks
+
+- [ ] Write the three failing tests in FoundationModelsACP.
+- [ ] Add `ClientSideConnection.afterRespondingToCurrentRequest` and the "not written" signal.
+- [ ] Push FoundationModelsACP and update `Package.resolved` here.
